speaker: A
name: Alex
text: I have a lot to say about this, but mainly — the takeout situation.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: I usually order takeout at school, but my school doesn't offer a proper place to put it.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Everything just gets left at the gate, and some people go there and pick up takeout that isn't even theirs — they basically steal other people's food.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: So I really wish my school would build a takeout cupboard, or at least a better place to store it, so our takeout doesn't get stolen so easily.
